title: Two squares side by side
prompt: Draw two squares of 30 side by side, with a gap of 40 between them.
hints: A square is forward 30 then turn left, four times; after four left turns the turtle faces the way it started, so a jump of 40 moves it along to the second square.
Square, then `jump(40)`, then the square again.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	jump(40)
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
